description: This file defines a Lexer class responsible for tokenizing JMESPath expressions by splitting input strings into tokens such as identifiers, operators, brackets, and literals based on a finite state machine and transition table.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: A class that tokenizes JMESPath expressions into an array of tokens, handling various token types like identifiers, operators, literals, brackets, and whitespace. It includes methods for tokenization and internal parsing helpers.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Main method that takes a JMESPath string input and returns an array of tokens, utilizing a transition table to identify token types and handle quoting, numbers, identifiers, and symbols.

methods.name: matchOr
methods.description: Helper method to determine if the next characters match an expected pattern and return the appropriate token type.

methods.name: inside
methods.description: Consumes and returns a token for string literals or JSON literals enclosed within delimiters, handling escape sequences, and returning an 'unknown' token if delimiters are unclosed.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON literal token value, attempting to decode it; on failure, it adds quotes and retries, marking the token as 'unknown' if invalid JSON.
